# STUFF'D Bagels

> Cape Town's first stuffed bagel. Fresh, handmade stuffed bagels sold at pop-ups at markets, events and cricket grounds across Cape Town every weekend. Order on WhatsApp, collect at the venue, pay with card (Yoco) or cash.

Slogan: "Every bite packed right." Cape Town, South Africa. Est. 2026. Street food, pop-up, handmade. No tables, no reservations.

## Menu (ZAR)
- Pizza Bagel: R75 (tomato, mozzarella, basil)
- Jalapeno Bagel: R70 (spicy, cream cheese, pickled)
- Cheesy Bagel: R65 (triple cheese, chive)
- Plain Bagel: R45 (classic, butter, sea salt)

## How ordering works
- Pick your bagels on the website, then send the ready-made order message on WhatsApp.
- Collect at the venue on your pickup date.
- Pay at the truck with Yoco (card) or cash. No online payment.
- Private events: message on WhatsApp for a custom quote.
